# Shape N Glow

> Shape N Glow is a physiotherapy and wellness center in Lebanon. It combines clinical recovery (physical therapy and EMS training) with body sculpting treatments (maderotherapy, body sculpting, cellulite and fat reduction, pressotherapy) under one roof, in personalised, therapist-guided plans.

## Treatments

- EMS Training: intelligent electrical muscle stimulation that activates deep muscle layers for an efficient full-body workout in a fraction of the time.
- Maderotherapy: a sculpting wooden-roller massage that stimulates circulation, helps smooth the skin and refines the body's contours.
- Body Sculpting: targeted treatments to firm, define and reshape problem areas as part of a guided transformation plan.
- Cellulite and Fat Reduction: non-invasive treatments that target stubborn areas to reduce the appearance of cellulite and refine texture.
- Pressotherapy: gentle compression therapy that supports lymphatic drainage, reduces puffiness and leaves the body feeling lighter.
- Physical Therapy: therapist-led rehabilitation for pain relief, mobility and recovery.

## How it works

1. Assess: a one-on-one consultation to understand your body, history and goals.
2. Plan: a personalised treatment plan blending recovery and sculpting services.
3. Treat: guided sessions with therapists using advanced, proven technology.
4. Glow: track progress as you move better, feel lighter and look radiant.
